properties.title: Oak Leaf knoll site analysis
properties.purpose: Describe the land for a slope-following redesign. Analysis only — no house proposed.

sources.resolution: 1 m (sampled at 1 m over the window)

sources.source: 2018 lidar CHM local maxima; crown_radius_dm as drip-line radius
sources.resolution: tops under 2.5 m not listed; positions integer decimetres
sources.note: No species column — on this knoll the recorded canopy is treated as the surveyed oaks. Owner edit trees-around-the-house flags removals within 12 m of the house footprint.

sources.resolution: 12 m buffer around county house footprint

properties.measured_note: Across the current Oak Leaf footprint the pack DEM falls 5.44 m, lowest toward the south-west (bearing 228°). This analysis covers the 100×100 m knoll window.
